name: AgentSimulator - Open
description: The dev panel open: the demo-sequence button, the by-hand tool runner, and the call log. It drives the same bound catalog a real agent calls, which is how the exchange is demonstrated where no agent can attach - and is also why the demo button now reads the map before it writes, refusing to replay its fixture nodes over a map that already holds real work. The tool runner beside it is unguarded on purpose: a person typing one tool name has said what they want.
